description: Add a podcast from a public podcast directory to OndaCast, by the directoryId that search_podcasts returned in notOnOndaCastYet. This creates the show's OndaCast page and is the only tool that changes anything. It takes no web address: only directory ids such as itunes-123 or pi-456. Additions are limited per client and per day.

directoryId.description: The directory id from search_podcasts, such as itunes-123456 or pi-789.

name: add_podcast
title: Add a podcast to OndaCast
